description: She wears an opaque navy floor-length gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a full skirt. Tan-gold geometric woven borders decorate the neckline, shoulder straps, cuffs, vertical front bands and hem. A cream underdress shows through the modest front walking opening beneath the knee. A narrow brown belt carries round bronze-toned ornaments and a central buckle; round matching clasps sit near the shoulders. A navy patterned fringed wrap rests across her forearms. Brown leather shoes show beneath the hem. No headgear or weapon is visible.
